title: Do maths on a vector
summary: R: Do maths on a vector. Multiply by 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: R can apply arithmetic to each value in a vector. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Do maths on a vector with R

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
The multiplication applies to every position: 2 becomes 4 and 3 becomes 6.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Different vector lengths can cause recycling; check their lengths.
